mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the proxy shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over three months signals an improving labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a weakening supply side, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the interaction condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the interaction condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over six months signals inflationary pressure, which leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in GDP (GDPC1) is negative and housing starts (HOUST) decrease by more than 5% in the same quarter, it signals a weakening demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < 0 & HOUST decreases > 5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the interaction condition is met.
